Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back. The players are on the field. Alyssa Healy and Beth Mooney are the openers for Australia Women. Will we get to see fireworks from their bat? Marufa Akter is ready to bowl the first over. Here we go...
... CHASE TIME ...

A target of 108 should not bother Australia Women much. Still, they will like to avoid getting too complacent and plan their chase carefully. The pitch has offered some spin and Bangladesh Women would look to create some chances. Stay tuned for the chase.

Nigar Sultana (57) comes up for a quick chat. She is disappointed to not bat the full quota of overs. Adds that the pitch is a good one for batting and she tried to build partnerships. Tells that Shorna Akter is so young and the advice to her was to rotate the strike and not panic. Hopes to build some pressure with the ball.

Nothing much to write home about Bangladesh Women's batting. Nigar Sultana notched up a fifty to become the first player from her country to do so in the ICC Women's T20 World Cup. Apart from her, everyone struggled.

A disciplined bowling show from Australia Women, as expected. All their bowlers adjusted to the conditions well and the watchful nature of Bangladesh's batting also assisted them. Georgia Wareham picked up three wickets and was the most successful bowler while the others brilliantly rallied around her.
Length delivery on middle, Marufa Akter has jabbed this towards long on and they end the innings with a single. Bangladesh Women end on 107 for 7.
Marufa Akter to face the final ball.

OUT! Given lbw! Megan Schutt bowls it from wide of the crease and angles in a length ball around middle, Nahida Akter tries to heave but misses. She is struck on the back leg, they appeal and the finger goes up. Akter starts to walk but then probably sees the signal from the dugout to take the referral. She does that. No bat on the UltraEdge and the Ball Tracking shows three reds.
Fuller delivery in the middle-stump line, Nahida chips this just ahead of the 30-yard circle towards the deep mid-wicket region and they get a couple.
Length delivery just outside off, Nahida has punched this towards short extra cover for a single. Meg Lanning has a wild shy at the bowler's end and they take the overthrow as well.
Short and wide outside the off-stump line, Ritu has cut this towards point for a single.
Length delivery on top of the off stump, Nahida has slapped this towards long on for a single.
Megan Schutt will bowl the final over.
Flighted delivery near the toes of Nahida, she manages to work this towards long on for a single.
Nahida Akter is in next.

OUT! TAKEN! Nigar Sultana is gone! Floated delivery, full and dipping in around off, Nigar Sultana jumps down the track for a big shot but only manages to slice it high in the air towards covers. Meg Lanning settles underneath it. A good knock from the skipper but she didn't receive much support from the other end.
Commentary.Howout: c Meg Lanning b Ashleigh Gardner

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller delivery around off, Ritu has slapped this away towards wide long on for a single.
Tossed-up delivery in the middle-stumps line, NIgar has pushed this towards the vacant mid-on region for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Nigar gets a deflection off her pads towards short third man fielder as she fails to sweep.
Flatter one around off, Nigar has pushed this back towards the bowler.
Change in bowling. Ashleigh Gardner to bowl out. 0 for 14 from her so far.
Short-pitched delivery around the waist, Nigar has pulled this flat towards the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Quicker one around off, Nigar blocks this out with a front-foot defensive stroke.
Fuller delivery just outside the off-stump line, Nigar has pushed this towards mid off.
Back of a length, way outside the off-stump line, Ritu cuts it towards point and takes a single.
Back of the hand delivery, on a length around off, Nigar pushes this towards cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Finds the fence! Full toss around off, Nigar Sultana goes down on one knee and powers it towards deep mid-wicket. Ellyse Perry tries her best but fails to cut it off in the deep.
Megan Schutt is back on. None for 7 from her two overs.
Peach of a delivery. Drifting in around leg and turning away towards off from there, Ritu Moni stands back to defend but is beaten all ends up.
Who will bat next? It's Ritu Moni.

OUT! BOWLED! Poor shot selection. A bit quicker through the air, full and on middle, Rumana Ahmed kneels down for the sweep shot but fails to connect. It goes on to rattle the stumps. All they need to do is support their skipper.
Length delivery around off, Rumana has tucked this towards the on side for no run. Pressure piling up on Rumana to bring Nigar back on strike.
Fuller delivery right in the blockhole, Rumana gets a thickish inside edge that deflects all the way towards the short fine leg fielder.
FOUR! Fine shot! Short in length and down the leg side, Rumana Ahmed turns inside the crease and paddles it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Rumana Ahmed is in next.

OUT! BOWLED! A nicely tossed-up delivery, drifting around leg and straightening a hint from there, Shorna Akter skips down the track but fails to reach the pitch of the delivery. She fails to work it around after that as the ball sneaks through and disturbs the stumps. The struggling knock of Shorna is over.
Georgia Wareham is back on.
Flighted delivery outside the off-stump line, Shorna walks down the track and drives this toward the deep extra cover region for a single.
Fuller delivery in the middle-stump line, Shorna has blocked this out.
FOUR! Tossed up, full and on middle, Shorna Akter shimmies down the track and smacks it over the bowler's head for a boundary.

FIFTY! Tossed-up delivery on and around off, Nigar has pushed this wide of the mid off fielder for a single. Nigar Sultana becomes the first Bangladesh Women's player to get a fifty in this tournament.
Full and wide outside the off-stump line, Nigar pushes this towards mid off for no run.
Length delivery outside off, Nigar has pushed this towards short cover.

Shout for an lbw, not given! A loopy leg spinner lands full around leg, Nigar Sultana goes down to sweep but doesn't connect cleanly. It perhaps takes the pads and goes to short fine leg. They cross. The bowler appeals but to no avail. Meg Lanning decides not to review.
Advances down the track to a full ball and forces it towards long on for a single.
Moves to 48! Loopy and full, around middle, Nigar sweeps it to deep backward square leg for one.
Wide! Quicker through the air, full but down the leg side, the batter attempts to sweep but misses.
Leans forward to a full ball and defends it to short cover.
Loopy and full, around leg, Sultana sweeps it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Sultana goes back and defends it down.
Put down! Brown serves it on a length and outside off, Nigar is early into the shot and slices it towards point. Beth Mooney puts in a dive to her right but fails to hold on to the catch. They cross.
FOUR! Fantastic shot! Short in length, around middle and leg, Nigar Sultana rides the bounce and pulls it firmly towards long leg for a boundary.
Back of a length, close to off, Sultana sits back and pushes it with an angled bat to backward point.
Wide called for height! A bouncer around leg, Sultana sits under it.
On a length around middle, Akter bunts it towards mid on for a quick run.
Short and on off, Akter stays back and plays it down to point.
Short in length and outside off, Sultana guides it towards backward point and crosses. The fielder fumbles slightly and makes the single easy.
Short and outside off, cut from the back foot to deep point for a single.
Floated around middle, Akter uses her feet to take it on the full and pushes it down to long on for a single.

Loopy around leg, Akter tries to flick but misses. It goes off her pads to square leg. The replays later on find that Australia Women have missed the trick. It's pitching in line and hitting the stumps.
Fuller and on off, driven through covers for a single.

FOUR! Nicely played! Short in length and outside off, Nigar Sultana camps back and cuts it firmly through point. It beats the dive of the fielder inside the ring and then beats the attempt from the sweeper cover fielder as well.
Flatter around leg, Sultana gets back and works it to mid-wicket.
Wide! Short and down the leg side, Nigar tries to pull but misses.
Georgia Wareham is back on. 1 for 8 in her 2 overs so far.
Tossed up around leg, spinning towards off, Akter helps it to mid-wicket.

Appeal for an lbw! Floated and full, around off and spinning away a hint, Sultana goes down and across to sweep but misses. It deflects off her pads to short fine leg and they cross. Alana King convinces her skipper for the DRS. The UltraEdge finds a spike as the ball passes the gloves. Australia Women waste the review. The umpire initially had given it as a leg bye and now it's changed to a run.
Tossed up, full and around off, Akter drags her attempted slog sweep to deep mid-wicket for one.
Walks down the track to a full ball and flicks. Finds mid-wicket.
Eases a full ball towards mid-wicket.
Loopy and full, on middle, Nigar sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Alana King will be looking to keep things tidy.
Back of a length, around off, Shorna defends from the back foot to the off side.
Full and angling in around off, Shorna clips it in front of square on the leg side. Looks for a run but she is sent back.
Wide! Down the leg side, on a length, Akter tries to flick but misses.
Wide! Bouncer down the leg side, the batter tries to pull but misses.

In the air but safe! Short and on off, shooting up from the surface, Shorna Akter leans back and fends it away aerially towards backward point. The keeper runs across and so does Meg Lanning from backward point but it falls safely.
Full in length and around off, Akter presses forward and wrists it towards mid-wicket.

Given caught behind! Shorna Akter shakes her head and takes the referral. Darcie Brown serves it on a shorter length, around leg and angling down, Shorna Akter tries to glance but fails to connect cleanly. There is some noise as it goes to Alyssa Healy and she appeals after taking the catch. The finger goes up. DRS time. No bat is involved, the UltraEde confirms. Akter survives.
Sharp delivery, on a length around middle and skidding off the surface, Shorna Akter tries to flick but gets a leading edge. It goes safely to point.

Drinks break. Bangladesh Women are showing some fight with the bat, especially their skipper but the others will also have to step up. They have put 53 runs on the board and need to do better in the next 10 overs to put up a challenge in front of Australia Women. Can they do it?​ Darcie Brown to bowl after the break.
Flighted delivery outside the line of off stump, Shorna gets this past the fielder short mid-wicket for a single.
Length dragged back a bit with a flatter trajectory, Shorna cuts this late but finds the fielder at short third man. There is confusion over a run and they decide not to cross.
Tossed-up delivery in the middle-stump line, Shorna has pushed this back towards the bowler.
Quicker on middle and leg, Sultana tries to flick but it takes the inside edge and rolls towards square leg. They cross.
Short, outside the off-stump line, Nigar cuts this but straight to the fielder at point.
Full and wide outside the off-stump line, Nigar has driven this towards the extra-cover fielder.
Tossed-up delivery in the middle-stump line, Nigar has driven this past the bowler for a single towards long on.
Very full and around off, forced down to long on for a run.
Fuller delivery around the off-stump line, Shorna has pushed this to the fielder at short mid-wicket for no run.
Fuller delivery around off, Nigar has worked this away towards the on side for a single.

FOUR! Nigar Sultana is playing a gem. Picks the short delivery early, goes deep inside the crease and pulls it powerfully through the gap between mid-wicket and square leg. No chance for the fielders in the deep.
Length delivery on the middle-stump line, Sultana tucks this down to the vacant short leg region.
Sliding down the leg side, Akter tries to flick but misses. She is rapped on the pads, a muted appeal for an lbw but nothing doing.
Length dragged back a bit, Nigar has pulled this towards the cow corner for a single.
Length delivery down the leg side, Shorna has nudged this towards the square leg region for a single.
Length delivery in the middle-stump line, Shorna has tucked this towards the fielder at short mid-wicket.

OUT! CAUGHT! Georgia Wareham bounces back by removing Sobhana Mostary. Flights this one in the air and lands it a bit short around leg, Sobhana Mostary stands back inside the crease, attempting to flick but closing the face of the bat early. The ball arrives late to take the leading edge and it's a simple catch for Alana King at short mid-wicket. Shorna Akter is the new batter.
Commentary.Howout: c Alana King b Georgia Wareham

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Shot! Sobhana Mostary getting into the act as well. Receives a full toss around middle and smashes it towards wide long on for a boundary.
Georgia Wareham is introduced into the attack.
Full and wide outside the line of off stump, Sobhana has sliced this towards third man for a single.
Fuller delivery around off, Sobhana Mostary has pushed this towards the short cover fielder.
Length delivery just outside off, Sobhana Mostary pokes at it but misses out.
Length delivery around the pads, Nigar Sultana has pulled this towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, on middle, Sobhana Mostary has nudged this towards square leg for a single.
Length delivery down the leg side, Nigar Sultana has under-edged her attempted flick shot, towards fine leg, for a single.
Ellyse Perry comes into the attack after the Powerplay.
Length delivery, body bound to Nigar Sultana, she places this just wide of the short cover fielder for a quick single to end the Powerplay. Bangladesh Women are 34 for 2!
SIX! Lovely footwork! Tossed up, around middle and in the slot for the batter, Nigar Sultana finds it in her range and launches it over long on for a maximum.
Flighted delivery around off, Nigar has blocked this out for no run.
FOUR! Put away! King drags her length short and delivers it outside off, Nigar leans back and smacks it through covers for a boundary.
A bit short and flatter in trajectory, Nigar edges this onto her pads as she attempts to pull.
Wide down the leg side, Sultana tries to flick but misses. Called a wide!
Leg break just outside off, Nigar looks to punch but misses out.
Spin from both ends. Alana King is also into the attack.
Flatter and on off, Sobhana Mostary helps it to mid-wicket and looks for a run. She is sent back.
Stumping chance is missed! Flighted and outside off, once again Sobhana Mostary advances down the track for a big shot but misses. It quickly goes to Alyssa Healy who fails to gather the ball.
Full and flighted around off, Sobhana Mostary walks down the track and drags it towards mid on.
Turning into the batter from outside off, some extra bounce too, Sobhana Mostary tries to flick from the back foot but misses and is hit high on the front leg.
A touch short and around middle, Sultana shuffles across and works it to the left of short fine leg. Takes a single.
Flighted and on off, Sultana flicks but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Ashleigh Gardner comes into the attack.
On a good length and close to off, Nigar runs it down to third man and retains strike with a single. 10 from the over along with a wicket.
FOUR! Another lovely drive. Full and wide outside off, shaping away, Nigar Sultana gets forward, opens the face of the bat and caresses it through backward point.
FOUR! Nice shot! Full in length and outside off, on a driving length, Nigar Sultana commits herself into the shot and thumps it past the point fielder for a boundary.
Wide! Sprays a bouncer down the leg side, Sultana ducks.
Short in length and outside off, Nigar Sultana eases it off the back foot but finds the point fielder.
Back of a length, around off, Nigar goes on her toes and plays it down towards point.
Nigar Sultana walks in next to join Sobhana Mostary.

OUT! BOWLED! Murshida Khatun misses a straightforward delivery. Fuller in length, landing around leg and heading towards middle and off, Murshida Khatun tries to flick but leaves a big gap open. Once she misses connecting, the ball has a good passage to go through and peg the middle stump back. Both the openers are dismissed.
A good over from Megan Schutt. Full in length and around off, Sobhana pushes it from the back foot to covers.
Back of a length, close to off, Sobhana Mostary shuffles and works it on the leg side, finds mid-wicket.
Ahead of a good length, outside off Sobhana mistimes her drive to covers.
Shortish and around off, Sobhana Mostary punches off the back foot to short cover.
Movement off the surface. An inswinger around off, landing on a length and nipping in, Mostary tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, Sobhana Mostary shuffles across the stumps and tries to flick but misses.
Length delivery outside off, Murshida again edges her attempted drive down to third man. Takes a run.
Edgy! Width there outside off, short in length, Murshida throws her bat at it and edges it down to third man. They cross.
Fuller and around off, Sobhana Mostary shows no footwork as she drives. It takes the outer half and runs down to third man for one.
Play and a miss! Short in length and outside off, shaping away, Mostary tries to cut but misses.
Sobhana Mostary walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Not a wicket-taking delivery but Brown gets lucky. It's short and wide outside off, begging to be put away, Shamima Sultana latches onto it and cuts it aerially. She doesn't get the desired elevation though to clear the infield and Beth Mooney at backward point jumps to catch it over her head. Early blow to Bangladesh Women!
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! Darcie Brown serves an outswinger, on a length outside off, Shamima Sultana tries to drive without any footwork and gets beaten.
On a good length, around middle, Khatun clips it to deep square leg for a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's Darcie Brown and she has kept a slip.
Drifting down the leg side, Khatun tries to flick but misses. It goes off her pads to short fine leg and they get a leg bye. Decent start from Bangladesh Women!

FOUR! Here comes the first boundary of the match and it's off the outside edge. Fuller and outside off, shaping away, Murshida Khatun tries to drive but it takes the outer edge and speeds through the gap between keeper and gully.
Back of a length, around off and angling away, Khatun stays back and dabs it down to point.
Lands it full and on middle, Murshida Khatun offers a straight bat as she defends it back.
Shortish, around middle and leg, Shamima Sultana plays a mistimed pull shot. It falls wide of the keeper, towards her left and they cross for a run. Bangladesh Women are underway!
Megan Schutt begins with a shortish delivery outside off, Shamima Sultana goes back and plays it with an angled bat to point.

Done with all the formalities. The Australian players are spreading on the ground. Shamima Sultana and Murshida Khatun are the openers for Bangladesh Women. Megan Schutt will take the new ball. Here we go...
The players from both teams have lined up in the middle for their national anthems. We're moments away from getting underway.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Alyssa Healy (WK), Beth Mooney, Meg Lanning (C), Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Tahlia McGrath, Grace Harris, Georgia Wareham (In for Jess Jonassen), Alana King, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown.

Bangladesh Women (Playing XI) - Shamima Sultana (WK), Murshida Khatun, Sobhana Mostary, Nigar Sultana (C), Shorna Akter, Rumana Ahmed (In for Jahanara Alam), Ritu Moni, Nahida Akter, Fahima Khatun (In for Lata Mondal), Salma Khatun, Marufa Akter.
TOSS - Bangladesh Women have won the toss and will BAT first.

On the other hand, Bangladesh Women got off to a sluggish start in their campaign as they were defeated by Sri Lanka Women by seven wickets. Batting first, Sobhana Mostary top-scored with a score of 29 as Bangladesh Women finished their innings on 126, and despite the fighting spirit of Marufa Akter, who scalped 3, the Bangladesh Women suffered a defeat. Now the challenge is even bigger and Bangladesh Women will have to unlock a lot more of their capabilities to give a fight to this Aussie side. Stay tuned for more...

The defending champions Australia will meet Bangladesh in the 8th match of the Women's T20 World Cup 2023 at St George's Park Cricket Ground. The five-time winners started off their campaign by defeating New Zealand in their first game. The Australia Women's team is loaded with players that can win games in any position. There are several impact players on this team, from Shutt and Perry in the bowling attack to Healy and Lanning in the top order. Their skipper, Lanning will be hoping for a smooth journey ahead without any upsets. The batting lineup is quite deep and the top order features some of the most consistent batters in this squad. In the recent match against New Zealand, Ashleigh Gardner showed just how good she can be with the ball. On the other hand, Bangladesh have already lost a match so far, in addition to both of their warm-up games. They lost by 7 wickets against Sri Lanka in their first game. Their batting troubles have persisted for a while now. Although they had performed somewhat better against Asian opponents, their confidence must have been shaken by the defeat against Sri Lanka. Can they bounce back and pull up a shocker against the mighty Australia Women? Let's find out together.
